name.description: zh-HK canonical name. Deliberately 'name' rather than 'title' (unlike books/memes/context) — a person has a name, not a title.

name_en.description: English name, reference only — not a full translation.

born.description: Birth year. 0 if unknown — don't guess.

died.description: Death year. OMIT THIS FIELD ENTIRELY if the person is living — presence of this field is how the site distinguishes living from deceased. Do not use 0 as a 'living' placeholder (0 is reserved for 'unknown' on `born`, not reused here).

roles.description: Open-ended, like themes/places — e.g. author, critic, barrister, legislator. Not a canonical enum; describe what they actually did.

books.description: GENERATED FIELD. Populated by tools/sync.js from every book's `authors:` and `people:` arrays via reverse lookup. Must not be present in committed source files — if a contributor adds it by hand, validate.js should flag this as an error, not silently accept it.
